scenes.name: Your Business

msgs.text: Day 1: Aapne [X] ke baare mein poocha tha. *Photos + price* 📎 ek jagah bhej diya.
Day 3: Ek sawaal aksar aata hai: *[delivery/time]*. Jawab: [..]

scenes.say: Pehle din sab ek jagah. Teesre din ek sawaal ka jawab. Saatve din: band kar doon?

scenes.text: "Band kar doon?" pe *sabse zyaada* reply aate hain.
scenes.say: Raaz ye hai. Band kar doon wale message pe sabse zyaada reply aate hain.
